===Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon===
In {{g|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}}, the player meets Samson earlier, namely before going to [[Big Wave Beach]] to [[Mantine Surf]] to [[Akala Island]], this replacing the initial encounter in Malie City. In these games, Samson studies [[Totem Pokémon]] and will give the player Totem-like Pokémon at [[Heahea Beach]] after they collect a certain number of [[Totem Sticker]]s. He is also an expert Mantine Surfer, initially holding the third-highest scores at all four of Alola's surfing beaches. The player can also encounter him at {{rt|12|Alola}} near [[Ula'ula Beach]], where he contemplates how he never seems to be able to beat a certain "[[Grimsley|kimono-clad cad]]" when it comes to the ranking boards.
